job_description:
Modeling and Simulation Software Engineers – Camden, NJ

Generous PTO, 401K, Health Insurance Package

Annual Salary Range: $90,000 - $150,000

In-Depth Engineering is seeking mid to senior level Software Engineers to support the design, development, integration, and verification of high-performance radar modeling and simulation. The successful candidate will have strong analytic and communication skills, and work well in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary environment. The work is performed on-site at our customer site in Camden, NJ. Work schedule - Flex 4/10 Schedule or Flex 9/80 w/every other Friday off - or a straight 5/8.

Qualified candidates must have an active DoD Secret Level Security Clearance.

In-Depth Engineering provides a competitive package of salary and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a Safe Harbor 401(k) program, generous Paid Time Off (PTO), STD, LTD, life insurance, and tuition assistance for higher education. Prospective employees will receive consideration without discrimination because of race, creed, color, sex, age, national origin, or handicap. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Duties

• Perform in an agile fast paced environment applying advanced technologies, software architecture, design, verification, validation, scientific principles, and concepts to develop revolutionary radar products

• Participate in the entire software development process to deploy and maintain critical radar software products

• Develop high quality solutions with a strong commitment to applying best software and system engineering practices

Basic Qualifications

• Must be a US citizen

• Have an active DoD secret clearance

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering related discipline

• Minimum 2 years of experience

• Proficiency in either C++ or other strong object-oriented programming experience

• Demonstrated analytical, applied mathematics, and problem solving skills

• Data analysis with MATLAB or Python

• Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: systems engineering, software engineering and system analysis, requirements development, verification and validation, trade studies, modeling and simulation, or integration and test

Desired Qualifications

• Aegis baseline/BMD experience

• Strong mathematics background in linear algebra, statistical analysis and signal processing.

• Functional knowledge of Radar systems, subsystems and designs with familiarity of design tools for radar modeling.

• Systems development experience including algorithms, software, data analysis, and modeling and simulation.

• Demonstrated analytical, applied mathematics and problem-solving skills
